events.summary: The team behind Reprompt AI (YC W24; runs 150M+ AI agents for customers like Visa, DoorDash and Tripadvisor; founders Lukas Martinelli and Rob Balian) joined Rippling on Nov 6, 2026 to take one of Rippling AI's biggest new directions from prototype to production.
events.headline: Reprompt AI is joining Rippling to build the future of agents

events.summary: Rippling announced an edge-enforced MCP gateway and MCP server: admins set policy in Rippling, Cloudflare Workers enforce it on every agent tool call (Slack, Google Calendar, customer-built tools), with permissions inherited from each person's role and every call logged.
events.headline: How Rippling governs AI agents at the edge

events.summary: Rippling integrated CrowdStrike endpoint protection into its Device Management platform on Nov 5, 2026 — customers can buy and manage Falcon Protect or Falcon Defend licenses, check sensor status, and view threats alongside device details in one console.
events.headline: Rippling + CrowdStrike: Advanced Endpoint Protection, Built into Device Management

events.summary: Rippling promoted Neel Murthy to Chief Marketing Officer, per an Oct 25, 2026 press sighting tracked by OpsControl (aggregator; the underlying Google News item was not directly retrievable, so exact announcement date is approximate).
events.headline: Neel Murthy elevated to Chief Marketing Officer at Rippling

events.summary: Rippling launched an out-of-home advertising campaign in Singapore (Raffles Place and People's Park) on Oct 21, 2026, targeting businesses hiring across borders, following the recent opening of its Singapore office; 71% of its Singapore customers employ people internationally.
events.headline: Rippling launches Singapore campaign for cross-border hiring

events.summary: On Oct 15, 2026 Rippling expanded Automated Compliance with AI workflows for GRC teams: multi-framework audit support (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA templates, custom frameworks; GDPR and PCI DSS slated for December), automated evidence collection with inline AI remediation, and a shareable trust center with AI-assisted security-questionnaire answers.
events.headline: Reintroducing Rippling Automated Compliance: AI for every stage of compliance

events.summary: Rippling opened a new 132,693-square-foot NYC office at 330 West 34th Street (announced Oct 8, 2026), nearly doubling its prior 67,000 sq ft New York footprint and built to support 1,000+ employees; the release also notes a Chicago office opening in 2027 and a permanent Toronto office later this year.
events.headline: Rippling Expands New York City Presence Amid Accelerated Growth

events.summary: A pricing tracker recorded on 2026-09-24 that the named plan 'Rippling Platform' (previously 'Contact sales / custom') was removed from rippling.com/pricing and replaced by a 'Custom quote' plan; Rippling's own pricing page (retrieved 2026-11-09) confirms the page is now quote-only: 'Tell us what services you need, and we'll send you a custom quote.' No USD prices are published (as of 2026-10-12 per an independent check).
events.headline: Plan 'Rippling Platform' removed; 'Custom quote' plan added on rippling.com/pricing
